label: Hip-Hop / Trap with Atmospheric Electronic influences

cards.mood: The track establishes a cold, imposing, and grandiose atmosphere from the outset, maintaining a high level of tension through relentless rhythmic drive.
cards.palette: A deep, distorted 808 sub-bass serves as the harmonic and rhythmic anchor, present from the very first beat and driving the entire track with sustained notes and sliding pitches.
